## Fig. 4a
```{r, results='hide', fig.width = 10, fig.height = 3}
num.link <- sapply(cellchat_list, function(x) {rowSums(x@net$count) + colSums(x@net$count)-diag(x@net$count)})
weight.MinMax <- c(min(num.link), max(num.link)) # control the dot size in the different datasets
gg <- list()
for (i in 1:length(cellchat_list)) {
  gg[[i]] <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(cellchat_list[[i]], title = names(cellchat_list)[i], weight.MinMax = weight.MinMax)
}

xr <- range(unlist(lapply(gg, function(p) ggplot2::ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x.range)))
yr <- range(unlist(lapply(gg, function(p) ggplot2::ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y.range)))

gg <- lapply(gg, function(p) p + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = xr, ylim = yr))

p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots = gg)

pdf(file.path(save.path, "CCC_scatter_plot.pdf"), width = 10, height = 3)
print(p)
dev.off()
p
```


## Fig. 4b
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5}
# --- Helper: reproduce CellChat's internal top/right bar values (same as CellChat source logic)
.get_role_bars <- function(object, signaling = NULL,
                           pattern = c("outgoing", "incoming", "all"),
                           slot.name = "netP") {
  pattern <- match.arg(pattern)
  
  centr <- slot(object, slot.name)$centr
  outgoing <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nlevels(object@idents),
    ncol = length(centr),
    dimnames = list(levels(object@idents), names(centr))
  )
  incoming <- outgoing
  
  for (i in seq_along(centr)) {
    outgoing[, i] <- centr[[i]]$outdeg
    incoming[, i] <- centr[[i]]$indeg
  }
  
  if (pattern == "outgoing") mat <- t(outgoing)
  if (pattern == "incoming") mat <- t(incoming)
  if (pattern == "all")      mat <- t(outgoing + incoming)
  
  if (!is.null(signaling)) {
    mat1 <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% signaling, , drop = FALSE]
    mat2 <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = length(signaling),
      ncol = ncol(mat),
      dimnames = list(signaling, colnames(mat))
    )
    idx <- match(rownames(mat1), signaling)
    mat2[idx[!is.na(idx)], ] <- mat1
    mat <- mat2
  }
  
  mat.ori <- mat
  top_bar <- colSums(mat.ori)      # top bar uses raw col sums
  
  # right bar uses transformed row sums in CellChat
  pSum <- rowSums(mat.ori)
  pSum.original <- pSum
  pSum <- -1 / log(pSum)
  pSum[is.na(pSum)] <- 0
  idx1 <- which(is.infinite(pSum) | pSum < 0)
  if (length(idx1) > 0) {
    values.assign <- seq(max(pSum) * 1.1, max(pSum) * 1.5, length.out = length(idx1))
    position <- sort(pSum.original[idx1], index.return = TRUE)$ix
    pSum[idx1] <- values.assign[match(seq_along(idx1), position)]
  }
  right_bar <- pSum
  
  list(mat.ori = mat.ori, top = top_bar, right = right_bar)
}

pathway.union <- union(
  union(cellchat_list[[1]]@netP$pathways, cellchat_list[[2]]@netP$pathways),
  cellchat_list[[3]]@netP$pathways
)
# --- Wrapper: create CellChat heatmap, then override top/right annotations with fixed ylim = c(0, 10)
netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap_fixed_ylim <- function(object, signaling = NULL,
                                                         pattern = c("outgoing", "incoming", "all"),
                                                         slot.name = "netP",
                                                         color.use = NULL,
                                                         color.heatmap = "BuGn",
                                                         title = NULL,
                                                         width = 10, height = 8,
                                                         font.size = 8, font.size.title = 10,
                                                         cluster.rows = FALSE, cluster.cols = FALSE,
                                                         bar_ylim = c(0, 10)) {
  pattern <- match.arg(pattern)
  
  # Get bar data FIRST to determine sort order
  bars <- .get_role_bars(object, signaling = signaling, pattern = pattern, slot.name = slot.name)
  
  # Compute per-pathway total strength (row sums of the heatmap matrix)
  pathway_order <- order(rowSums(bars$mat.ori), decreasing = TRUE)
  sorted_signaling <- rownames(bars$mat.ori)[pathway_order]
  
  # Build heatmap using the SORTED pathway order
  ht <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
    object,
    signaling = sorted_signaling,   # <-- pass sorted order instead of original
    pattern = pattern,
    slot.name = slot.name,
    color.use = color.use,
    color.heatmap = color.heatmap,
    title = title,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    font.size = font.size,
    font.size.title = font.size.title,
    cluster.rows = cluster.rows,
    cluster.cols = cluster.cols
  )
  
  # Re-extract bars using sorted_signaling so annotation aligns correctly
  bars <- .get_role_bars(object, signaling = sorted_signaling, pattern = pattern, slot.name = slot.name)
  
  if (is.null(color.use)) {
    color.use <- CellChat::scPalette(ncol(bars$mat.ori))
    names(color.use) <- colnames(bars$mat.ori)
  } else {
    if (is.null(names(color.use))) names(color.use) <- colnames(bars$mat.ori)
  }
  
  ht@top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(
      bars$top,
      ylim = bar_ylim,
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = color.use, col = color.use)
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )
  
  ht@right_annotation <- rowAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(
      bars$right,
      ylim = bar_ylim,
      border = FALSE
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )
  
  ht
}


# --- Loop and save
for (i in seq_along(cellchat_list)) {
  
  if (!is.null(names(cellchat_list)) && nzchar(names(cellchat_list)[i])) {
    sample_name <- names(cellchat_list)[i]
  } else {
    sample_name <- paste0("Condition_", i)
  }
  
  message("Processing: ", sample_name)
  
  ht1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap_fixed_ylim(
    cellchat_list[[i]],
    pattern = "outgoing",
    width = 5, height = 8,
    bar_ylim = c(0, 10),
    signaling = pathway.union
  )
  ht2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap_fixed_ylim(
    cellchat_list[[i]],
    pattern = "incoming",
    width = 5, height = 8,
    bar_ylim = c(0, 10),
    signaling = pathway.union
  )
  
  pdf(
    file = file.path(save.path, paste0(sample_name, "_SignalingRole.pdf")),
    width = 6.5, height = 5
  )
  draw(ht1 + ht2, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"))
  dev.off()
  draw(ht1 + ht2, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"))
}
```

## Fig. 4c, d
```{r, results='hide', fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6, message=FALSE}
group.dataset <- "datasets"
control <- "Aged control"

cc_UL <- mergeCellChat(
  cellchat_list[c(control, "IPF upper lobe")],
  add.names = c(control, "IPF upper lobe")
)


dim(cc_UL@data.signaling)

pos.dataset   <- "IPF upper lobe"
features.name <- "IPF_upper_lobe_vs_Aged_control"

cc_UL <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(
  cc_UL, group.dataset = group.dataset, pos.dataset = pos.dataset,
  features.name = features.name, only.pos = FALSE,
  thresh.pc = 0.1, thresh.fc = 0.05, thresh.p = 0.05,
  group.DE.combined = FALSE
)

net_UL <- netMappingDEG(cc_UL, features.name = features.name, variable.all = TRUE)
net_UL_up   <- subsetCommunication(cc_UL, net = net_UL, datasets = pos.dataset, ligand.logFC =  0.05)
net_UL_down <- subsetCommunication(cc_UL, net = net_UL, datasets = control,     ligand.logFC = -0.05)

pairLR.use.up = net_UL_up[, "interaction_name", drop = F]
gg1 <- netVisual_bubble(cc_UL, pairLR.use = pairLR.use.up, sources.use = c("Alveolar", "Adventitial"), targets.use = c("Inflammatory"), comparison = c(1, 2),  angle.x = 90, remove.isolate = T)


p <- netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat_list[[2]], sources.use = c("CTHRC1+"), targets.use = c("Inflammatory"), slot.name = 'net', net = net_UL_up, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5)
pdf(file.path(save.path, "CCC_chord_IPF_UL_up.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()
p

p <- netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat_list[[2]], sources.use = c("Alveolar", "Adventitial"), targets.use = c("SMCs"), slot.name = 'net', net = net_UL_down, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5)
pdf(file.path(save.path, "CCC_chord_IPF_UL_down.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()
```
